title: A number changed on the Part Library page reaches open PO lines, canned jobs and open returns everywhere
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Data: QAPL-T2 (stocked at both locations) with open PO lines at Staging Heavy Duty and at Staging Lethbridge, plus the seeded hand-typed PO line; one fully received PO line for QAPL-T2 at Staging Heavy Duty (receive one in setup if none exists); canned job "QAPL Canned" holding QAPL-T1 and QAPL-I1 (with a fee on I1); a not-completed vendor return on QAPL-T4.
custom_steps:
1. Parts > Part Library > open QAPL-T2 > pencil > Part Number "QAPL-T2-RN" > Save.
  2. Open the open PO holding QAPL-T2 at Staging Heavy Duty, then switch to Staging Lethbridge and open the open PO holding QAPL-T2 there.
  3. Back at Staging Heavy Duty, open the PO with the fully received QAPL-T2 line.
  4. Inventory > QAPL-T2-RN row > history icon, at Staging Heavy Duty and then at Staging Lethbridge.
  5. Part Library > open QAPL-T1 > pencil > Part Number "QAPL-T1-RN" > Save; then open the canned job "QAPL Canned".
  6. Part Library > open QAPL-T4 > pencil > Part Number "QAPL-T4-RN" > Save; then open the not-completed vendor return on it.
  7. Rename QAPL-T2-RN, QAPL-T1-RN and QAPL-T4-RN back to QAPL-T2, QAPL-T1 and QAPL-T4 from the Part Library pencil.
custom_expected:
1. While typing, "This also changes the part number at 1 other location." shows. Save succeeds; the detail page reads QAPL-T2-RN.
  2. The open QAPL-T2 lines read QAPL-T2-RN at both locations; the hand-typed line keeps its own typed text.
  3. The fully received line still reads QAPL-T2.
  4. Heavy Duty: "Part number updated | Original number: QAPL-T2 | New number: QAPL-T2-RN". Lethbridge: the same entry ending "| Changed at: Staging Heavy Duty".
  5. Saved; the canned job lists QAPL-T1-RN; the QAPL-I1 line and its fee are unchanged.
  6. Saved; the return line reads QAPL-T4-RN.
  7. Each save succeeds; the open PO lines, the canned job and the return show the original numbers again.
